note.text: Deferred productization: after this repository-specific MicroVM work is complete and its isolation model, prerequisites, operational constraints, and limitations are understood, create a separate Tiber ticket for Development System. That follow-up should add a Development System command that detects and explains prerequisites, safely installs or configures the trusted host-side infrastructure, and sets up the declarative project-side MicroVM integration for any repository using Development System. Do not generalize prematurely or fold that reusable automation into this ticket; derive it from the verified implementation and preserve the rule that agent-writable project code cannot create its own host security boundary.
